world.title: Pakistan strikes 10 Afghan sites after alleged drone incursions
world.summary: Pakistan said it launched strikes in Afghanistan early Thursday, a day after alleging that drones from Afghan territory entered Pakistani airspace. Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said air defenses detected and neutralized the drones before they reached their intended targets. Afghan Taliban spokesman Zabihullah M
world.content: Pakistan said it launched strikes in Afghanistan early Thursday, a day after alleging that drones from Afghan territory entered Pakistani airspace. Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said air defenses detected and neutralized the drones before they reached their intended targets. Afghan Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid denied Wednesday that Afghan forces launched drones at Pakistan; Kabul had not immediately commented on the latest strikes. A spokesperson for the Khost provincial governor said Pakistani strikes hit several sites, including sites near the provincial center, at about 3:30 a.m., with no casualties reported there. A Kandahar resident separately told AFP that the city was struck; the resident heard an aircraft and an explosion, then saw a fire.
world.image_alt: Pakistan strikes 10 Afghan sites after alleged drone incursions

world.title: Argentina
world.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei used his Sept. 23 address to the U.N. General Assembly in New York to renew Argentina’s sovereignty claim over the Falkland Islands, known in Argentina as the Malvinas, and urge Britain to resume negotiations on a peaceful settlement. He accused the U.N. of failing to act on the dispute
world.content: Argentine President Javier Milei used his Sept. 23 address to the U.N. General Assembly in New York to renew Argentina’s sovereignty claim over the Falkland Islands, known in Argentina as the Malvinas, and urge Britain to resume negotiations on a peaceful settlement. He accused the U.N. of failing to act on the dispute and criticized the Sea Lion offshore oil project in the North Falkland Basin, arguing that UK-licensed activity was unilateral and violated a U.N. resolution. Milei said Argentina would not wait for the U.N. or the international community to act and would take steps in response to resource exploitation. He called for peaceful talks and did not advocate military action. The speech focused on General Assembly Resolution 31/49, which calls on both countries to refrain from unilateral changes while the sovereignty dispute remains unresolved.

world.title: US Navy confirms eight suicide attempts in Lincoln group
world.summary: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao told Democratic Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand in a Sept. 22 letter that eight people assigned to the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group attempted suicide during its deployment and that there were no suicide deaths. The figure includes personnel across the carrier and its wider strike grou
world.content: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao told Democratic Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand in a Sept. 22 letter that eight people assigned to the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group attempted suicide during its deployment and that there were no suicide deaths. The figure includes personnel across the carrier and its wider strike group. The deployment included U.S. military operations against Iran. News reports also cited food shortages and poor sanitation aboard the ship. President Donald Trump rejected concerns about conditions, while Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said they had been misrepresented.
world.image_alt: US Navy confirms eight suicide attempts in Lincoln group

world.title: Trump-backed board proposes $2.45 billion Gaza recovery plan
world.summary: President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace presented a six-month, $2.45 billion recovery proposal for Gaza on Sept. 23 in New York. The plan includes 66 projects for temporary housing, debris removal, hospital repairs, economic recovery and security. The board said the package would begin reconstruction and establish gove
world.content: President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace presented a six-month, $2.45 billion recovery proposal for Gaza on Sept. 23 in New York. The plan includes 66 projects for temporary housing, debris removal, hospital repairs, economic recovery and security. The board said the package would begin reconstruction and establish governance under Trump’s 20-point plan to end the Israel-Hamas war. The board estimates physical damage at $35.2 billion and says full recovery and reconstruction will require about $71.4 billion over the next decade. Implementation remains uncertain because the proposal depends on cooperation between Israel and Palestinians. Board officials cited difficult negotiations with Israel ahead of its Oct. 27 election and acknowledged delays.
world.image_alt: Trump-backed board proposes $2.45 billion Gaza recovery plan

world.title: U.S. invites Putin to December G20 summit in Miami
world.summary: The United States invited Russian President Vladimir Putin to the G20 leaders’ summit scheduled for Dec. 14-15 at Trump National Doral near Miami, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Sept. 23 after meeting Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York. Rubio said the s
world.content: The United States invited Russian President Vladimir Putin to the G20 leaders’ summit scheduled for Dec. 14-15 at Trump National Doral near Miami, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Sept. 23 after meeting Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York. Rubio said the summit would give Putin a chance to speak with President Donald Trump and other world leaders as Washington pursues efforts to end the war in Ukraine. Rubio said a Trump-Putin meeting had not been agreed upon. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Moscow welcomed the invitation and would decide whether Putin would attend through diplomatic channels. The Kremlin had not confirmed whether he would go.
world.image_alt: U.S. invites Putin to December G20 summit in Miami

world.title: Venezuela’s interim leader pledges elections without setting a date
world.summary: Venezuela’s interim President Delcy Rodríguez told the U.N. General Assembly in New York on Wednesday, Sept. 23, that the country would hold elections as part of a transition to “full democracy.” She said her government had begun political dialogue with opposition groups and would ensure equal participation, while leav
world.content: Venezuela’s interim President Delcy Rodríguez told the U.N. General Assembly in New York on Wednesday, Sept. 23, that the country would hold elections as part of a transition to “full democracy.” She said her government had begun political dialogue with opposition groups and would ensure equal participation, while leaving the timing to Venezuelans and setting no date for the vote. Rodríguez said state institutions would ensure an inclusive and transparent process. She took office after U.S. forces captured former President Nicolás Maduro in January and brought him to the United States to face drug-trafficking charges. In her speech, she thanked President Donald Trump for resuming diplomatic relations.
world.image_alt: Venezuela’s interim leader pledges elections without setting a date

world.title: AI leaders urge UN safeguards as Trump rejects rules
world.summary: OpenAI chief Sam Altman, Anthropic chief Dario Amodei and Hugging Face co-founder Clément Delangue addressed the U.N. Security Council in New York on Sept. 23, urging governments to establish safeguards and coordinate internationally as AI systems become more capable. France convened the meeting during the U.N. General
world.content: OpenAI chief Sam Altman, Anthropic chief Dario Amodei and Hugging Face co-founder Clément Delangue addressed the U.N. Security Council in New York on Sept. 23, urging governments to establish safeguards and coordinate internationally as AI systems become more capable. France convened the meeting during the U.N. General Assembly. It focused on preventing the loss of human control and the concentration of AI power in a single company or country. In his address to the General Assembly, President Donald Trump rejected a global system to control AI, putting Washington at odds with calls for international safeguards.
world.image_alt: AI leaders urge UN safeguards as Trump rejects rules

world.title: Tigrayan forces seize airports as fighting spreads in Ethiopia
world.summary: Tigrayan forces seized airports in the northern Tigray region as fighting was reported in neighboring Afar. Ethiopian government adviser Getachew Reda accused Tigrayan fighters of taking federally administered airports and launching offensives in Afar and Amhara. Tigray’s regional authorities said their forces were fig
world.content: Tigrayan forces seized airports in the northern Tigray region as fighting was reported in neighboring Afar. Ethiopian government adviser Getachew Reda accused Tigrayan fighters of taking federally administered airports and launching offensives in Afar and Amhara. Tigray’s regional authorities said their forces were fighting defensively after federal attacks. Ethiopian Airlines suspended flights to Mekelle, Shire and Axum. The escalation follows months of tension and mutual accusations of violating the 2022 peace deal, as well as the TPLF’s recent alliance with six other armed groups seeking to remove Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. The African Union’s mediator estimated that the 2020-2022 war killed about 600,000 people.
world.image_alt: Tigrayan forces seize airports as fighting spreads in Ethiopia

business.title: Micron shares face test as memory demand narrative shifts
business.summary: Micron Technology shares have become a “battleground” as investors debate whether demand for memory chips can hold up, MarketWatch reported. UBS analyst commentary cited by MarketWatch identified factors supporting demand durability, while investors have focused on how long current demand can last. A Seeking Alpha anal
business.content: Micron Technology shares have become a “battleground” as investors debate whether demand for memory chips can hold up, MarketWatch reported. UBS analyst commentary cited by MarketWatch identified factors supporting demand durability, while investors have focused on how long current demand can last. A Seeking Alpha analysis said memory-price increases are moderating as supply and demand rebalance, while AI data-center demand remains strong. It identified potential pressure from rising industry supply, customer inventory build-ups and labor negotiations in Taiwan.

business.title: Trump discloses July trades in tech and AI stocks

The disclosures also listed trades in Nvidia, Palantir and
business.content: President Donald Trump disclosed millions of dollars in stock transactions made on his behalf in July, including Microsoft share sales valued between $6.5 million and $31 million and purchases valued between $165,000 and $400,000, according to official filings. The disclosures also listed trades in Nvidia, Palantir and SpaceX. The White House said third parties independently manage Trump’s stock and bond portfolio. The filings showed more than 1,000 trades. They also listed sales of Amazon and Meta shares, according to filing details reported by the South China Morning Post.

business.title: OECD warns inflation will persist as borrowing costs rise
business.summary: The OECD said global inflation in 2027 would likely be higher than previously forecast and raised its consumer-price projections for most G20 economies from June; China and Saudi Arabia were exceptions. It expects the U.S. Federal Reserve to raise rates once more in 2026, with smaller increases in the euro area, Austra
business.content: The OECD said global inflation in 2027 would likely be higher than previously forecast and raised its consumer-price projections for most G20 economies from June; China and Saudi Arabia were exceptions. It expects the U.S. Federal Reserve to raise rates once more in 2026, with smaller increases in the euro area, Australia and South Korea and further increases in Japan, while forecasting no changes in Britain or Canada. The OECD cited energy prices, strong demand and uncertainty over international trade as inflation risks. The OECD also warned that government bond yields in developed economies had reached their highest levels in 15 years, increasing borrowing costs and pressure on public finances. It linked the rise to concerns about debt sustainability and increased borrowing by artificial-intelligence companies.
business.image_alt: OECD warns inflation will persist as borrowing costs rise

business.title: Oil slips as Iran keeps diplomacy open, Saudi supply returns
business.summary: Oil prices edged lower on Thursday, Sept. 24, after gaining about 4% in the previous session. Brent fell 0.9% to $102.13 a barrel and U.S. West Texas Intermediate dropped 0.7% to $91.56, as traders weighed Iran’s stated willingness to continue diplomacy against the remaining gap between Tehran and Washington. A senior
business.content: Oil prices edged lower on Thursday, Sept. 24, after gaining about 4% in the previous session. Brent fell 0.9% to $102.13 a barrel and U.S. West Texas Intermediate dropped 0.7% to $91.56, as traders weighed Iran’s stated willingness to continue diplomacy against the remaining gap between Tehran and Washington. A senior Iranian official said Tehran was reviewing Washington’s response to proposals calling for the lifting of the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Saudi Arabia also began restoring crude flows through its East-West pipeline, an export route to the Red Sea. The previous day, oil had fallen below $100 after President Donald Trump described a three-hour U.S.-Iran meeting at the United Nations as productive, but prices rose again as the impasse persisted.
business.image_alt: Oil slips as Iran keeps diplomacy open, Saudi supply returns

business.title: AI leaders seek U.N. safeguards as U.S. resists oversight
business.summary: Executives from OpenAI, Anthropic and Hugging Face told the U.N. Security Council on Sept. 23 that increasingly capable AI systems could pose risks if humans lose control of their development and use. Anthropic chief Dario Amodei said poorly managed AI could threaten humanity, while OpenAI chief Sam Altman called for i
business.content: Executives from OpenAI, Anthropic and Hugging Face told the U.N. Security Council on Sept. 23 that increasingly capable AI systems could pose risks if humans lose control of their development and use. Anthropic chief Dario Amodei said poorly managed AI could threaten humanity, while OpenAI chief Sam Altman called for international cooperation and safeguards. France convened the 15-member council session during the U.N. General Assembly. President Trump rejected efforts to create a global AI-control system in his U.N. address, while Chinese Ambassador Fu Cong called for stronger regulation, emergency response and cross-border cooperation.
business.image_alt: AI leaders seek U.N. safeguards as U.S. resists oversight

business.title: Bentley launches first electric SUV with £350m Crewe upgrade
business.summary: Bentley unveiled the Torcal, its first fully electric vehicle, on Sept. 23. The luxury SUV starts at £173,300 in the UK, making it Bentley’s least expensive model. Bentley aims to attract younger and first-time buyers. It is part of a £350 million upgrade to Bentley’s Crewe factory, where the Torcal will be built and w
business.content: Bentley unveiled the Torcal, its first fully electric vehicle, on Sept. 23. The luxury SUV starts at £173,300 in the UK, making it Bentley’s least expensive model. Bentley aims to attract younger and first-time buyers. It is part of a £350 million upgrade to Bentley’s Crewe factory, where the Torcal will be built and where the investment is expected to support 4,000 jobs. Bentley says the Torcal can travel up to 375 miles (600 km) on a charge under the WLTP test cycle.
business.image_alt: Bentley launches first electric SUV with £350m Crewe upgrade

business.title: U.S.-China extend trade truce through January 10, 2027
business.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington and Beijing agreed on Sept. 23 to extend their Busan Agreement trade truce by two months, through Jan. 10, 2027. The arrangement had been due to expire Nov. 10. Bessent announced the extension after meeting Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in Washington, as Chinese Pr
business.content: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington and Beijing agreed on Sept. 23 to extend their Busan Agreement trade truce by two months, through Jan. 10, 2027. The arrangement had been due to expire Nov. 10. Bessent announced the extension after meeting Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in Washington, as Chinese President Xi Jinping began a three-day state visit to the United States. Bessent said the extra time would allow officials to pursue a broader economic agreement but left open the possibility of simply renewing the existing arrangement. He said it was not yet clear whether a larger deal could be reached by the new deadline.
business.image_alt: U.S.-China extend trade truce through January 10, 2027

business.title: Trump and Xi prepare for Washington talks on AI, trade
business.summary: President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping began a three-day state visit Wednesday, Sept. 23, when Trump greeted Xi and his wife, Peng Liyuan, at Joint Base Andrews. The leaders are scheduled to meet at the White House on Thursday, Sept. 24, to discuss trade, artificial intelligence, Taiwan and the Iran wa
business.content: President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping began a three-day state visit Wednesday, Sept. 23, when Trump greeted Xi and his wife, Peng Liyuan, at Joint Base Andrews. The leaders are scheduled to meet at the White House on Thursday, Sept. 24, to discuss trade, artificial intelligence, Taiwan and the Iran war. It will be their second face-to-face meeting this year and Xi’s first U.S. state visit since 2015. The discussions follow a May meeting in Beijing, where the governments agreed to pursue a “constructive relationship of strategic stability,” though differences over trade, technology and geopolitical issues remain. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the sides discussed a proposed AI safety notification channel to alert each other when AI systems pose threats or behave unpredictably. The articles do not report that the two governments have agreed to establish it.
business.image_alt: Trump and Xi prepare for Washington talks on AI, trade

science.title: Paris archaeologists uncover 20-metre Gallic wall beneath hospital
science.summary: Archaeologists uncovered a roughly 20-metre stone-and-wood wall beneath the Hôtel-Dieu hospital on Paris’s Île de la Cité during excavations this summer. The structure may be part of the fortifications of Gallic Lutetia, the settlement of the Parisii tribe and a precursor to Paris; France’s culture ministry described t
science.content: Archaeologists uncovered a roughly 20-metre stone-and-wood wall beneath the Hôtel-Dieu hospital on Paris’s Île de la Cité during excavations this summer. The structure may be part of the fortifications of Gallic Lutetia, the settlement of the Parisii tribe and a precursor to Paris; France’s culture ministry described the find as a major breakthrough in investigating the city’s origins. The find bears on the longstanding dispute over whether Lutetia stood on Île de la Cité or in Nanterre, west of Paris. Traces of fire and first-century B.C. artifacts at the site are consistent with accounts of the Roman conquest, but Culture Minister Catherine Pégard said archaeologists still need to determine the wall’s precise function and chronology.
science.image_alt: Paris archaeologists uncover 20-metre Gallic wall beneath hospital

science.title: UBC researchers identify two new Salish Sea sea spiders
science.summary: Researchers at the University of British Columbia identified two previously unknown sea-spider species during dives in the Salish Sea near Vancouver. The team, led by master’s student Cormac Toler-Scott, described the species in a study published in the journal Organisms Diversity & Evolution. The species are Callipall
science.content: Researchers at the University of British Columbia identified two previously unknown sea-spider species during dives in the Salish Sea near Vancouver. The team, led by master’s student Cormac Toler-Scott, described the species in a study published in the journal Organisms Diversity & Evolution. The species are Callipallene pilosuspedes, which has red eyes, and Tanystylum kiixin, which is covered in parasites. Both have leg spans of about a centimetre; T. kiixin’s short legs make it difficult for the animal to clean itself, attracting parasites.
science.image_alt: UBC researchers identify two new Salish Sea sea spiders

science.title: Study finds crown-of-thorns starfish can support reef diversity
science.summary: University of Sydney research challenges the view that crown-of-thorns starfish are solely destructive, finding that controlled populations can positively affect coral prevalence and diversity. Separately, NPR reported that scientists are studying some of the world's most pristine reefs to learn how reefs elsewhere mig
science.content: University of Sydney research challenges the view that crown-of-thorns starfish are solely destructive, finding that controlled populations can positively affect coral prevalence and diversity. Separately, NPR reported that scientists are studying some of the world's most pristine reefs to learn how reefs elsewhere might recover.
science.image_alt: Study finds crown-of-thorns starfish can support reef diversity

science.title: Study links Earth
science.summary: Researchers at the University of Nottingham reported in the journal Aging on Sept. 23 that reducing Earth’s magnetic field affected fruit fly lifespans differently depending on their health: diseased flies lived longer, while healthy flies had shorter lifespans. The researchers described it as a first-of-its-kind exper
science.content: Researchers at the University of Nottingham reported in the journal Aging on Sept. 23 that reducing Earth’s magnetic field affected fruit fly lifespans differently depending on their health: diseased flies lived longer, while healthy flies had shorter lifespans. The researchers described it as a first-of-its-kind experiment and said it raised questions about potential risks for future human space travel. The articles linked the findings to mitochondria and energy production and described possible relevance to therapies for Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s.

science.title: Satellites document 12.5 trillion tons of polar ice loss
science.summary: An international research team estimates that Greenland and Antarctica lost 12.5 trillion tonnes of ice over 47 years from 1979. The loss raised global sea levels by about 31.4 millimeters, according to the study. The analysis combined satellite observations with findings from earlier research to track ice-sheet mass l
science.content: An international research team estimates that Greenland and Antarctica lost 12.5 trillion tonnes of ice over 47 years from 1979. The loss raised global sea levels by about 31.4 millimeters, according to the study. The analysis combined satellite observations with findings from earlier research to track ice-sheet mass loss. Researchers distinguished ice loss that directly contributes to sea-level rise from other changes in the ice sheets.
science.image_alt: Satellites document 12.5 trillion tons of polar ice loss

science.title: North Sea fossils point to plesiosaurs regurgitating shell remains
science.summary: Geologist Dirk Knaust identified fossilized clumps in Jurassic rock cores drilled beneath the North Sea as plesiosaur regurgitalites, the remains of meals expelled after digestion. The material contains shells and other marine remains and dates to about 160 million years ago. Corroded shell surfaces and a mixture of re
science.content: Geologist Dirk Knaust identified fossilized clumps in Jurassic rock cores drilled beneath the North Sea as plesiosaur regurgitalites, the remains of meals expelled after digestion. The material contains shells and other marine remains and dates to about 160 million years ago. Corroded shell surfaces and a mixture of remains support the interpretation that the clumps were regurgitated. Knaust suggested plesiosaurs may have approached the coast after hunting to expel indigestible remains.
science.image_alt: North Sea fossils point to plesiosaurs regurgitating shell remains

science.title: Stanford study finds different developmental paths for hindbrain and forebrain
science.summary: A Stanford study published in Nature Neuroscience found that the hindbrain develops differently from the forebrain and midbrain. The findings challenge the assumption that all brain regions arise from a common neuroectodermal stem cell. The study concerned development and did not find that adults have two separate brai
science.content: A Stanford study published in Nature Neuroscience found that the hindbrain develops differently from the forebrain and midbrain. The findings challenge the assumption that all brain regions arise from a common neuroectodermal stem cell. The study concerned development and did not find that adults have two separate brains.
science.image_alt: Stanford study finds different developmental paths for hindbrain and forebrain

science.title: MeerKAT detects radio bursts from exoplanet Beta Pictoris b
science.summary: Astronomers using South Africa’s MeerKAT radio telescope detected radio bursts traced directly to Beta Pictoris b, a gas giant about 63 light-years from Earth. Earlier radio signals from exoplanet systems could not be confidently separated from emissions from their host stars; the team used precise position measurement
science.content: Astronomers using South Africa’s MeerKAT radio telescope detected radio bursts traced directly to Beta Pictoris b, a gas giant about 63 light-years from Earth. Earlier radio signals from exoplanet systems could not be confidently separated from emissions from their host stars; the team used precise position measurements to identify the planet as the source. The bursts are attributed to auroras generated by the planet’s magnetic field, not an artificial signal. The study reports a direct measurement of the field, but the findings are in a preprint that has not yet undergone peer review.
science.image_alt: MeerKAT detects radio bursts from exoplanet Beta Pictoris b

sports.title: Cantona says he would not have joined United under Ratcliffe
sports.summary: Eric Cantona said on September 23 that he would not have joined Manchester United in 1992 if Sir Jim Ratcliffe had been in charge, responding to the club co-owner’s recent comments on immigration in the UK. Cantona said he could not understand how a club owner could make such comments. Ratcliffe told the BBC that the U
sports.content: Eric Cantona said on September 23 that he would not have joined Manchester United in 1992 if Sir Jim Ratcliffe had been in charge, responding to the club co-owner’s recent comments on immigration in the UK. Cantona said he could not understand how a club owner could make such comments. Ratcliffe told the BBC that the UK was “on the slide” and that politicians were not tough enough on immigration and benefits. He later apologized for his wording but said authorities needed to act. Ratcliffe has previously called Cantona his favorite Manchester United player.
sports.image_alt: Cantona says he would not have joined United under Ratcliffe

sports.title: England captain Kane considers future MLS and NFL roles
sports.summary: England captain Harry Kane said he is considering a future as an NFL placekicker and possibly playing in Major League Soccer. The 33-year-old discussed the idea at England’s Nations League training camp on Wednesday, saying any move to the United States is several years away and will depend on his career, motivation an
sports.content: England captain Harry Kane said he is considering a future as an NFL placekicker and possibly playing in Major League Soccer. The 33-year-old discussed the idea at England’s Nations League training camp on Wednesday, saying any move to the United States is several years away and will depend on his career, motivation and ambitions over the next five or six years. Kane said he is happy at Bayern Munich and wants to play soccer at the highest level for as long as he can. He is coming off a reported 73-goal season and is among the contenders for next month’s Ballon d’Or. He described the NFL as a more realistic post-soccer option than professional golf.
sports.image_alt: England captain Kane considers future MLS and NFL roles

sports.title: Liverpool have no January plan to sell Wirtz as Bayern opt out
sports.summary: Liverpool have no immediate plans to sell Florian Wirtz in January, while Bayern Munich have reportedly decided not to pursue the 23-year-old playmaker, according to reports published on September 23. Wirtz joined Liverpool from Bayer Leverkusen in 2025 for a reported total fee of £116 million. He has seven goals and 1
sports.content: Liverpool have no immediate plans to sell Florian Wirtz in January, while Bayern Munich have reportedly decided not to pursue the 23-year-old playmaker, according to reports published on September 23. Wirtz joined Liverpool from Bayer Leverkusen in 2025 for a reported total fee of £116 million. He has seven goals and 11 assists in 55 appearances for the club, while his first Premier League goal involvement did not come until his 13th match. His adaptation has drawn criticism from pundits and fans.
sports.image_alt: Liverpool have no January plan to sell Wirtz as Bayern opt out

sports.title: Ireland players to decide protest over Israel fixtures
sports.summary: Republic of Ireland captain Dara O’Shea said the squad would meet after Thursday’s Nations League opener against Kosovo to discuss their approach to two upcoming matches against Israel. He said the issue required time for discussion, while manager Heimir Hallgrímsson acknowledged that his remarks about “playing against
sports.content: Republic of Ireland captain Dara O’Shea said the squad would meet after Thursday’s Nations League opener against Kosovo to discuss their approach to two upcoming matches against Israel. He said the issue required time for discussion, while manager Heimir Hallgrímsson acknowledged that his remarks about “playing against genocide” had diverted attention from the Kosovo match. Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin defended Hallgrímsson and called the Israel Football Association’s personal criticism of the manager unacceptable, saying the association should withdraw it. Ireland are scheduled to play Israel on neutral ground after security and operational concerns prompted the relocation of the Irish-hosted fixture.
sports.image_alt: Ireland players to decide protest over Israel fixtures

sports.title: Gordon urges England to use strengths against Spain
sports.summary: Anthony Gordon has urged England to play to their own strengths rather than imitate Spain, saying controlling matches through possession is not part of English football’s established style. He spoke as England prepare to face world champions Spain on Saturday in their first match since the World Cup. England lost 2-1 t
sports.content: Anthony Gordon has urged England to play to their own strengths rather than imitate Spain, saying controlling matches through possession is not part of English football’s established style. He spoke as England prepare to face world champions Spain on Saturday in their first match since the World Cup. England lost 2-1 to Argentina in the World Cup semi-final after Gordon scored before being substituted. They later beat France 6-4 to finish third, their best World Cup placing since 1966. Gordon said the semi-final defeat still affects him but could help the squad approach future tournaments differently.
sports.image_alt: Gordon urges England to use strengths against Spain

sports.title: China
sports.summary: China’s Yu Zidi, 13, won all three of her individual races at the Asian Games, taking the women’s 400-meter individual medley on Wednesday, September 23, in 4:28.56. She led from start to finish, set a Games record and finished 3.95 seconds ahead of silver medalist Ke Wenxi; Japan’s Mio Narita took bronze. Yu had alrea
sports.content: China’s Yu Zidi, 13, won all three of her individual races at the Asian Games, taking the women’s 400-meter individual medley on Wednesday, September 23, in 4:28.56. She led from start to finish, set a Games record and finished 3.95 seconds ahead of silver medalist Ke Wenxi; Japan’s Mio Narita took bronze. Yu had already won the 200-meter butterfly and 200-meter individual medley, also in Games-record times. Her 400-meter time cut nearly 4.5 seconds from the record set by China’s Ye Shiwen in 2014. Yu’s age has prompted discussion about the demands and expectations placed on young athletes. Yu, who turns 14 in October, has been tipped as a possible medal contender at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

sports.title: Danish midfielder Christian Eriksen leaves Wolfsburg after collapsing
sports.summary: Christian Eriksen and VfL Wolfsburg agreed on September 23 to end his contract by mutual consent, about nine months before it was due to expire in June 2027. The 34-year-old has not played since collapsing during Denmark’s friendly against Ukraine in Odense on June 7. He said being close to his family in Denmark was no
sports.content: Christian Eriksen and VfL Wolfsburg agreed on September 23 to end his contract by mutual consent, about nine months before it was due to expire in June 2027. The 34-year-old has not played since collapsing during Denmark’s friendly against Ukraine in Odense on June 7. He said being close to his family in Denmark was now important to him. The June incident revived memories of Eriksen’s cardiac arrest during Denmark’s Euro 2020 match against Finland in 2021. Eriksen said his implanted defibrillator had delivered a shock and that he was doing well. He has since been in rehabilitation in Denmark. Wolfsburg, now in Germany’s second division after relegation, accepted Eriksen’s request to leave. He has not said whether he will resume playing.
sports.image_alt: Danish midfielder Christian Eriksen leaves Wolfsburg after collapsing
